verses.text: The LORD said to me, "Go and buy a linen belt and put it around your waist, but do not let it touch water."
So I bought a belt, as the LORD told me, and put it around my waist.
Then the word of the LORD came to me a second time:
"Take the belt you bought, the one you are wearing, and go now to the Euphrates River. Hide it there in a crack in the rocks."
So I went and hid it by the Euphrates, as the LORD commanded me.
Many days later the LORD said to me, "Go now to the Euphrates and get the belt I told you to hide there."
So I went to the Euphrates and dug up the belt from the place where I had hidden it. But look, the belt was ruined. It was good for nothing.
Then the word of the LORD came to me:
"This is what the LORD says: 'In the same way I will ruin the pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem.
These evil people refuse to listen to my words. They follow their stubborn hearts and go after other gods to serve and worship them. They will be like this belt, good for nothing.

For just as a belt is wrapped tightly around a person's waist, so I wrapped all the people of Israel and Judah around me,' says the LORD, 'so that they would be my people, bringing me fame, praise, and honor. But they would not listen.'

So tell them this: 'This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Every wine jar should be filled with wine.' And they will say to you, 'Do we not already know that every wine jar should be filled with wine?'

Then tell them, 'This is what the LORD says: Look, I am going to fill everyone who lives in this land with drunkenness, the kings who sit on David's throne, the priests, the prophets, and all the people of Jerusalem.
I will smash them against each other, parents and children alike,' says the LORD. 'I will not show pity, or spare them, or have mercy. Nothing will stop me from destroying them.'"
Listen and pay attention. Do not be proud, for the LORD has spoken.
Give glory to the LORD your God before he brings darkness, before your feet stumble on the dark mountains. You hope for light, but he will turn it into deep darkness and thick gloom.
But if you will not listen, I will weep in secret because of your pride. My eyes will cry bitterly and overflow with tears, because the LORD's flock will be taken away as captives.
Say to the king and the queen mother, "Come down from your thrones and sit in the dust, for your glorious crowns will fall from your heads."
The towns in the south of Judah will be shut tight, and no one will be able to open them. All Judah will be taken away as captives, every one of them.
Look up and see the enemy coming from the north. Where is the flock you were given to care for, your beautiful flock?
What will you say when the LORD puts over you as rulers those you once made your allies? Will pain not grip you like a woman giving birth?
And if you ask yourself, "Why has this happened to me?" It is because of your many sins that your skirts have been torn off and your body has been treated so cruelly.
Can an Ethiopian change his skin, or a leopard its spots? Neither can you do good, you who are used to doing evil.
"I will scatter them like straw blown away by the desert wind.
This is your share, the portion I have measured out for you," says the LORD, "because you have forgotten me and trusted in lies.
So I will pull your skirts up over your face, and your shame will be seen.

I have seen your disgusting acts, your adulteries and your lustful neighing, your shameless prostitution on the hills and in the fields. How terrible for you, Jerusalem! How long will you go on being unclean?"
